description.en: Soft semolina cake soaked in lemon syrup.
description.ro: Prăjitură fragedă din griș, înmuiată în sirop de lămâie.
description.ar: كيكة سميد طرية مغموسة بشراب الليمون.

ingredients: For the syrup: 1 cup sugar, 1 cup water, 1 tbsp lemon juice
steps: Heat the oven to 180 C and grease a square tin.
Mix the semolina, yoghurt, sugar, butter and baking powder and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Spread in the tin, cut into diamonds and press an almond into each piece.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until golden.
Meanwhile boil the syrup ingredients for 8 minutes and let it cool.
Pour the cool syrup over the hot cake and leave it to soak for 20 minutes.

description.en: Chickpeas simmered in a fragrant tomato and spice sauce.
description.ro: Năut fiert într-un sos aromat de roșii și condimente.
description.ar: حمص مطهو في صلصة طماطم وبهارات عطرة.

ingredients: 3 cloves garlic and 1 tbsp grated ginger
Fresh coriander and lemon to serve
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic and ginger, then the spices, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until they break down.
Stir in the chickpeas with 1/2 cup water and simmer for 12 minutes.
Season, then finish with the coriander and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with rice or flatbread.

description.en: Smooth chickpea and tahini dip, ready in ten minutes.
description.ro: Pastă fină de năut și tahini, gata în zece minute.
description.ar: غموس ناعم من الحمص والطحينة جاهز في عشر دقائق.

ingredients: Olive oil and paprika to serve
steps: Blend the tahini and lemon juice for 1 minute until pale and thick.
Add the garlic, chickpeas and salt and blend until very smooth, adding the cold water a spoon at a time.
Spread on a plate, drizzle with olive oil and dust with paprika.
اخفقي الطحينة وعصير الليمون في الخلاط دقيقة حتى يصبح الخليط فاتحاً وسميكاً.
أضيفي الثوم والحمص والملح واخلطي حتى يصبح ناعماً جداً مع إضافة الماء البارد ملعقة ملعقة.
افرديه في صحن ورشي عليه زيت الزيتون والبابريكا.

description.en: Creamy cornmeal porridge topped with salty cheese and sour cream.
description.ro: Mămăligă cremoasă cu brânză sărată și smântână.
description.ar: عصيدة ذرة كريمية مع جبن مالح وقشدة حامضة.

steps: Bring the salted water to the boil.
Pour in the cornmeal in a thin stream, whisking so no lumps form.
Lower the heat and stir with a wooden spoon for 20 minutes until it pulls away from the pot.
Stir in the butter, spoon onto plates and top with the cheese and sour cream.
Fierbe apa cu sare.
Toarnă mălaiul în fir subțire, amestecând continuu ca să nu se formeze cocoloașe.
Scade focul și amestecă cu o lingură de lemn 20 de minute, până se desprinde de pe pereții oalei.
Adaugă untul, pune în farfurii și acoperă cu brânză și smântână.

description.en: A layered pot of rice, vegetables and chicken that is turned upside down to serve.
description.ro: O oală cu straturi de orez, legume și pui, răsturnată la servire.
description.ar: قدر من طبقات الأرز والخضار والدجاج يُقلب عند التقديم.

steps: Simmer the chicken with the cinnamon, half the allspice and salt in 4 cups of water for 30 minutes. Keep the stock.
Fry the aubergine and cauliflower until golden and drain them.
Line the base of a heavy pot with the tomato slices, then layer the chicken, the vegetables and the rice.
Mix the turmeric and the rest of the allspice into 3 cups of the hot stock and pour it over the rice.
Cook covered on low heat for 35 minutes, then rest for 10 minutes.
Turn the pot over onto a large platter, lift it off, and top with almonds.
اسلقي الدجاج مع القرفة ونصف البهار الحلو والملح في 4 أكواب ماء لمدة 30 دقيقة واحتفظي بالمرق.
اقلي الباذنجان والقرنبيط حتى يحمرّا وصفّيهما.
افرشي قاع قدر ثقيل بشرائح الطماطم ثم رصّي الدجاج والخضار والأرز.
اخلطي الكركم وباقي البهار الحلو مع 3 أكواب من المرق الساخن وصبّيه فوق الأرز.
اتركيه مغطى على نار هادئة 35 دقيقة ثم دعيه يرتاح 10 دقائق.
اقلبي القدر على صحن كبير وارفعيه وزيّنيه باللوز.

description.en: Thin crepes rolled around fruit jam.
description.ro: Clătite subțiri rulate cu dulceață de fructe.

steps: Whisk the eggs, milk and sparkling water, then add the flour, sugar and salt and whisk until smooth.
Rest the batter for 15 minutes.
Brush a pan with oil and cook a thin layer of batter for about 1 minute on each side.
Spread each crepe with jam, roll it up and serve warm.
Bate ouăle cu laptele și apa minerală, apoi adaugă făina, zahărul și sarea și amestecă până se omogenizează.
Lasă aluatul să se odihnească 15 minute.
Unge tigaia cu ulei și coace un strat subțire de aluat cam 1 minut pe fiecare parte.
Unge fiecare clătită cu dulceață, rulează și servește caldă.

description.en: A smooth, lemony soup that comes together in one pot.
description.ro: O supă cremoasă cu lămâie, gătită într-o singură oală.
description.ar: شوربة ناعمة بالليمون تُطهى في قدر واحد.

steps: Soften the onion, carrots and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, then add the lentils and the stock.
Bring to the boil, then simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils collapse.
Blend until smooth, stir in the lemon juice and season to taste.

description.en: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
description.ro: Ouă pocate într-un sos condimentat de roșii și ardei.
description.ar: بيض مطهو في صلصة طماطم وفلفل متبلة.

ingredients: Fresh parsley or coriander to serve
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook the onion and pepper for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, paprika and cumin and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes, season, and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Make four hollows in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until the whites are set. Scatter the herbs and serve with bread.

description.en: Garlic, olive oil and chilli: dinner in fifteen minutes.
description.ro: Usturoi, ulei de măsline și ardei iute: cină în cincisprezece minute.
description.ar: ثوم وزيت زيتون وفلفل حار: عشاء في خمس عشرة دقيقة.

steps: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted water until just al dente. Keep a cup of the pasta water.
Warm the oil with the garlic over low heat until pale gold, then add the chilli.
Add the drained spaghetti and a splash of pasta water and toss for 1 minute.
Finish with the parsley and serve at once.

description.en: A fresh parsley salad with tomato, mint and bulgur.
description.ro: O salată proaspătă de pătrunjel cu roșii, mentă și bulgur.
description.ar: سلطة بقدونس طازجة مع الطماطم والنعناع والبرغل.

ingredients: 1/4 cup fine bulgur, soaked in water for 15 minutes and drained
steps: Squeeze the soaked bulgur dry and put it in a bowl.
Add the parsley, mint, tomatoes and spring onions.
Dress with the lemon juice and olive oil, season, and toss gently.
Rest for 10 minutes and serve with crisp lettuce leaves.
